final_message: {"title":"花太多了","poses":["0.00 s: Draw X on the left, right fingers closing around the single stem in florist N’s right hand; X’s left palm waits beneath it, and N’s left hand rests on the counter.","0.45 s: Draw X cradling the stem in the left arm, right hand securing it; N bends slightly, reaching the right hand below the counter; both watch the flower.","1.00 s: Draw N’s right hand releasing a first bunch onto X’s waiting arms at chest height; X looks pleased, and N’s left hand stays planted.","1.60 s: Draw N’s right hand delivering a second bunch onto the existing flowers, raising the stack to X’s eyes; X peers over it with widening eyes.","2.20 s: Draw N withdrawing the empty right hand after adding a third bunch; flowers completely hide X except for the silver cowlick, with both supporting hands concealed underneath.","2.90 s: Draw X bending knees and lowering the entire armful to chest height, revealing overwhelmed eyes; both hands remain underneath, while N watches with the right hand empty.","3.50 s: Draw X crouched behind the counter, placing the whole armful into concealed storage; only the silver cowlick peeks above the edge, while N reaches below with the right hand.","4.00 s: Draw X rising behind the counter with empty hands and a relieved expression; N lifts a fresh single stem in the right hand, left hand still resting on the counter.","4.55 s: Draw X upright with the left palm cupped and open right fingers just short of the offered stem; N extends it toward those fingers, and both look at the approaching handoff."],"continuity":"Use one fixed camera for a 4.8-second loop, keep N’s left hand planted and each person limited to two hands, preserve every bunch until X stores it below the counter, and connect pose nine’s approaching fingers directly to pose one’s closing grip."}
